los_file_ascending.description: DISP-S1-STATIC line_of_sight_enu of the ascending frame.
los_file_ascending.title: Los File Ascending

los_file_descending.description: DISP-S1-STATIC line_of_sight_enu of the descending frame; required with descending inputs.
los_file_descending.title: Los File Descending

InputFileGroup.description: Primary input files of one job.

frame_id.description: Frame ID of the products to process.
frame_id.title: Frame Id

ascending_disp_files.description: Ascending DISP products (DISP-S1 for VLM-S1, DISP-NISAR for VLM-NI) of the frame stack.
ascending_disp_files.title: Ascending Disp Files

descending_disp_files.description: Descending DISP products over the same area. If absent, vertical comes from the single-geometry projection (mode 2) everywhere.
descending_disp_files.title: Descending Disp Files

ascending_cal_files.description: DISP-CAL products matching each ascending DISP product (same reference/secondary dates).
ascending_cal_files.title: Ascending Cal Files

descending_cal_files.description: DISP-CAL products matching each descending DISP product; required when descending_disp_files is given.
descending_cal_files.title: Descending Cal Files

unr_grid_latlon_file.description: UNR grid lookup of the frozen snapshot. Used for GNSS east/north only when the DISP-CAL products carry no gnss_ve/gnss_vn layers; the provenance hash must then match the one in DISP-CAL.
unr_grid_latlon_file.title: Unr Grid Latlon File

unr_timeseries_dir.description: Node files of the frozen UNR snapshot (nodes/ of unr_grid_<version>_<date>); see unr_grid_latlon_file.
unr_timeseries_dir.title: Unr Timeseries Dir

processing_facility.title: Processing Facility

product_data_access.description: URL (or DOI) where this product can be retrieved.
product_data_access.title: Product Data Access

keep_scratch.description: Keep the scratch directory after a successful run (debugging).
keep_scratch.title: Keep Scratch
